title: fix: deploy Composio MCP secret
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the encrypted Composio API key for Worker deployments.
- Uses the existing SOPS secret-file pattern used by hosted MCP workers.
- Fixes production agents loading zero Composio tools.

Checks: Composio credential HTTP 200; worker tests pass; Wrangler production dry run detects the hidden binding.

gist.headline: The tools found their hive
gist.blurb: Production agents can now open the Composio tool shed again. The encrypted key made the trip to Worker deployments, and the empty toolbox problem has stopped pretending to be a feature.
gist.summary: Added the encrypted Composio API key to the composio-mcp Worker deployment using the existing SOPS secret-file pattern, so production agents load Composio tools instead of zero tools.
gist.impact: Agents using the production Composio MCP worker regain access to its connected tools, with the hidden Worker binding verified by a Wrangler production dry run.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a friendly CRT monitor robot unlock a cozy garden tool shed labeled COMPOSIO, with glowing API tool icons inside to represent production agents regaining their tool catalog. Use an encrypted key and a small secret-file scroll as visual symbols, plus code-plants and flowers to show the deployment secret safely reaching the worker.
